name: Sakuragaoka Yumemaru
source:
He became a doctor after researching milk disease because he wanted to help young people suffering from the same disease as himself as a youth.

He has received a grant from the World Health Organization for his contribution to the treatment and research of milk disease, which is a very rare disease.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/nyuuin/index.html]official site[/url]]
